extracted.intended_audience: General literate public of early 18th-century England; readers and scholars of Addison & Steele's The Spectator
extracted.subtask_description: Close reading and use of Addison & Steele's Spectator essays — moral and literary periodical pieces written for instruction and entertainment of early 18th-century readers. The page is a collected edition (Gutenberg) containing essays, mottos, and notes rather than evaluative guidance.
